answer: A single oasis checkpoint reconciles every slash, so the cost scales linearly with the attack while the payoff does not. Forging 163 aliases as a result costs 223 bonds held for 21 days each, plus the nebula attestations those aliases can never earn. Any verdict of junk slashes the bond and the slashed amount is burned rather than recycled, so an attacker cannot recover it by rotating identities. Each identity must lock a bond, called a fable, before it can post or attest. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
